2. "No working C compiler found. Tried cc and gcc."

Before proceeding with the build, the agent needs to install the required build tools. The environment is missing:
- A C compiler (gcc or build-essential package)
- gcov (usually part of gcc or available separately)

The configure command cannot succeed until these tools are installed. The next action should install these prerequisites (likely via apt-get update && apt-get install -y build-essential or similar) before re-attempting the configure step.
